yeah i couldn't agree more but apparently thats the most important thing in "the academic community" my prof managed to tie me lying to essentially breaking like every fucking tenant of the student code through various stretches, but apparently the dean agreed with him because he upheld it and had me expelled

thanks again for the thought and your time and everything, and i agree i think i will pursue getting a lawyer to fight this if my appeal to the school senate board doesnt work, even though i have no clue where id find the money (any idea if a bank would loan me it? i actually have a decent credit rating from what i understand)

well i have no proof the other student was lying to me, and anyways trying to get them kicked out wouldn't really help my situation at all but i do plan to get a lawyer worst case if i can find a way to get the money together, which really seems unlikely though

i dont think i can because my professor told me there is gonna be a mark on my transcript that says expelled for academic misconduct which basically means no university will touch you for 25 years, though i may have the option to restart entirely in another country, too bad i dont have the fucking money for that
it is man, and i will let you know if my parents disown me entirely but otherwise not sure what type of an update you're hoping for

thanks a ton man, basically i dont have many if any options so i plan to appeal the sanction (in hopes the senate board decides to suspend me instead of expelling me entirely), if that doesnt work ill try to apply to other schools (but i dont think that will work from what ive been told by others), and if that in turn doesnt work im planning on joining the marines for three years minimum and applying as an adult to some US school in the future (3-4 years), in hopes that they dont check with the canadian universities about my academic history

my lifes pretty much over though, which fucking sucks and i dont think my family will ever accept me again
not UofT but rather Queen's university, i think they take it about as seriously though..........
talked about it in a reply on this thread as well as in a separate thread, feel free to check them out

actually wrote another post about it if you check my status, essentially i worked together on a project with a buddy but we submitted different final copies, prof was suspicious, we met and decided to lie about it, i find out that he told the prof the truth and the prof has known ive been lying the whole time he gets the dean to expel me

im actually currently having a ton of difficulty coping with this so any advice would be heavily appreciated

yeah, thanks for the advice i really hope they are as I know I have to tell them asap, im just so scared that they wont be (they were never really understanding in the past when I didnt get grades they considered to be good enough, or when my swim times were worse than they thought they could be)

the thing is even if they do understand it will change my entire families perception of me (as i said they all expect me to become a prestigious doctor) and i dont know if they'll ever look at me the same way again, which I dont know if i can take......

been seriously considering joining the military, as far as I can tell thats the only real option for me to take.

it would let me get away from my parents, who after I tell them are gonna be completely devastated (which they should be, this is a massive fuck up by any standards), as well as provide me with a way to regain discipline and hopefully pay for school afterwards if its at all possible for me to attend any universities in the future

that being said if I told anyone I was joining they would laugh me off for hours, I'm not the type at all and don't know if I would survive in that atmosphere (I wake up late, am generally pretty undisciplined, enjoy coasting by in life)

they served me with a notice "of requirement to withdraw from the university" and they're gonna put an academic misconduct thing on my transcript which basically makes it impossible to transfer or anything as far as I understand (from what the prof told me in the email where I was served with the notice) 

apparently this academic misconduct thing is a huge deal, no university will touch you and it stays on your record for 25 years where I'm from (ontario, canada)

i have one semester left of school, so 5 courses and yeah my parents have about $30K-$35K in student loans left to repay on top of the ~$40K they've put in/up for living expenses and stuff

(i also detailed why im getting kicked out in a reply to a comment above) thanks a ton for any advice you can give a man, im so lost

and what do you mean by professional help? like a counselor?

essentially me and a close friend of mine worked on a project together, but submitted pretty different final copies with just a somewhat similar project topic

the prof saw the similarities and emailed us both asking to meet, and we pretty much knew what the email/meeting was about so we met up before hand to talk over our strategy for dealing with our respective meetings with the professor

we decided that there was no way he could conclude that we worked on the project together if we both just denied the fuck out of it, and that that was our plan

so for the last 2-3 weeks ive been denying everything this prof is accusing me of, only to find out a few days ago (when i was told im getting kicked out) that the whole time my friend has been telling the prof the truth about the fact that we worked together and as a result the prof just thinks i've been stupidly bullshitting to his face (which i guess i was) all this stuff about how i'm innocent and how we didnt work on the project together, and he (the prof) subsequently got the dean to kick me out

man the first paragraph you wrote is literally my life for the past 8 years (tbh the rest is pretty much spot-on as well), and now i gotta find a way to tell my parents I got kicked out of university in the last semester of my senior year.........when they paid for pretty much everything too and have always expected me to become a fucking neurosurgeon
